🤝1-1 OpenClaw Setup/Integration - https://calendly.com/beaujohnson1/ai-mastermind

OpenClaw 4.7 dropped at 2am with a massive upgrade to how your AI agent thinks, remembers, and connects to your stack. Memory Wiki, webhooks, session restore, media fallback, and more.

In this video, Beau breaks down:
0:00 - OpenClaw 4.7 dropped at 2am and everything changed
1:00 - Memory Wiki: from sticky notes to real knowledge management
3:00 - openclaw infer: one-liner inference from the CLI
4:30 - Webhooks: your agent is now wired into your entire stack
6:30 - Session branch and restore: version control for agent memory
8:00 - Memory Dreaming upgrade: smarter overnight learning
9:30 - Media generation auto-fallback across providers
10:30 - New model support: Gemma 4, Arcee AI, Ollama vision
11:30 - Pluggable compaction and systemPromptOverride
12:30 - Why 4.7 is not optional if you're building with OpenClaw
